strict_path_reachability.source_semantics: B5-C shortest_strict_steps: legal one-field neighbor edges whose score strictly increases, ending at any global optimum
strict_path_reachability.rank_encoding: 0 if no strict path exists; otherwise 1/(1+shortest_strict_steps)
strict_path_reachability.justification: monotone ordinal encoding of the B5-C reachable/shorter-is-better semantics for frozen rank analyses; not a soft, weighted, or learned proxy

primary_decision: earliest generation with reconstructible incumbent, chosen candidate and successor, at least two legal graph neighbors, computable immediate score and reachability, and non-empty future trajectory
immediate_score: recorded candidate behavioral_score after deterministic evaluator identity check
